main_text.l: per Ecclesias divulgata, non modo quæ
addidit sub Asterisco, sed etiam nonnul-
issimi sunt illi Codices, qui paucioribus
tui, omnes alias, tuumque Codicem hac
allata de Codice tuo experiaris, [illegible, ~5 letters]
est in Codice tuo totus Liber Jobi:
ex-cipienda tamen essent duo priora capita,
ultimumque caput à v. 7. ad finem, ut
est. Sed universa illa Libri scriptio ma-
Hebraicorum distinctiones Neotericum esse inventum, non modo Codicis tui

page.notes: Greek word after "experiaris," (about five letters, with accents and a stray mark) could not be read reliably and is marked illegible. The abbreviated word after "interpretationib" is a doubtful form (printed q-like abbreviation); marked [?] and read as "interpretationibus". The text is a single unbroken paragraph on this page; the first line continues from the previous page.
